assisted_grasp: Profile 17 = profile 16 with the hand colliding with the graspable objects (2026-10-23, tools/assisted_grasp_check/RESULTS.md). Under profile 16 a SAPIEN drive from the hand to every leaf and to the can switched their collision off for the whole episode, and the hand went 36-57 mm through the leaves in every episode; utils/mikasa/assisted_grasp.py now holds through a shapeless proxy. With the hand colliding, the BIMBO swing (planners/cabinet_door_bimbo.py) ends when the leaf stops against the hand (> 1 N, < 0.005 rad over 8 controls), ~1.69-1.72 rad, instead of pressing it for a 60-control stall window. Validated 13/15 acceptable (5/5 and 9/10 succeed; one knocked can rejected by the can-early gate). Still assisted_grasp=True in env_kwargs (owner 2026-10-18), the BIMBO door (cabinet_search_planner.door_mode), HAND_TURN 0 (owner 2026-10-23).

touch_preparation_room: Profile 19 = profile 18 with the touch readied 0.10 m short of the touch dock (cabinet_search_planner.NUDGE_LEVEL_ROOM_M; 2026-10-23, tools/assisted_grasp_check/RESULTS.md): the ready posture, the torso raise and the joint line to the level hand run there with the can in the planning world, then the base rolls in, arm frozen. Profile 18 was never collected.
five_compartments: cabinet_search profile 19 with cab_1, the west wall unit, as compartment 0 (my_scenes/cabinet_search.CabinetSearch5Config: horizon 9000, cab_1's door tangible), branch feat/cabinet-fifth-door, 2026-10-24. cab_1 is opened by its handle to 1.28 rad, held through the look (the right base camera centred on the compartment; looked at 0.5 s like the other leaves, ~1 s from the end of its opening to the swing shut) and swung shut on the same grip (planners/cabinet_door_fist.py, MODE bar); a can found there is touched after the leaf is swung on to 1.60. Every other leaf closes with the fist turned by the wrist alone, slides 6 cm off the bar along the shut leaf, backs off 0.30 m by the hand servo (contact and leaf-drag stops, the base reverses the rest) and only then opens (planners/cabinet_retrieval_planner.py FIST_WRIST_FIRST, FIST_RETREAT_SERVO, RETREAT_SLIDE_M, FIST_OPEN_OFF_PANEL; the fold to the drive posture turns the wrist back with the rest of the arm). Pipeline trials on 7991300-323: 15/16 accepted (trial-001), 24/24 (trial-003). Collection declared 2026-10-24 by the owner: «дофиксить версию с 5 отсеками и записать ее».

profile_3: Profile 3 = profile 2 with an empty cab_1 held 70 steps instead of 120 (CAB1_EMPTY_LOOK_STEPS): the arm stands still on the bar 4.5 s from the end of the opening, not 7 s. profile_4: Profile 4 = profile 3 with no extra hold on an empty cab_1 (CAB1_EMPTY_LOOK_STEPS 0): the camera looks into it for reveal_dwell_steps (0.5 s) like every other leaf, the arm still on the bar ~1 s. profile_5: Profile 5 = profile 4 with the wrist-first turn and the fist made during the pre-contact move (FIST_TURN_ON_THE_WAY): the sequential screw path with the turn blended in, the gripper closing from its first knot on an even step; the sequential order is the fallback. ~2.5 s shorter per fist close. The owner, 2026-10-24: «Поворачивать гриппер у других дверей и закрывать его можно одновременно». Profile 4 (c5v4-train-*, seeds from 7920400) is not part of the dataset.
profile_6: Profile 6 = profile 5 without the separate wrist turn back after a fist close (FIST_WRIST_BACK off): the fold to the drive posture sets the wrist roll with every other arm joint, so the gripper turns while the arm returns to rest; ~2.5 s shorter per fist close. The owner, 2026-10-25: «После закрытия тоже можно одновременно поворачивать гриппер и возвращаться в rest позу». Profile 5 (c5v5-train-001..005, seeds 7920500-7920599) is not part of the dataset.
profile_7: Profile 7 = profile 6 with the fist opening during its back-off, 0.20 m off the leaf (FIST_OPEN_WHILE_BACKING), and the fold to the drive posture before the closure is read (FOLD_BEFORE_VERIFY): the release dwell runs during the fold.
